extracted.name: One pan Cookie (with induction)
extracted.description: Great recipe for One pan Cookie (with induction).
instruction_lines: Melt the butter, then add to a bowl with the brown and white sugar
In a separate bowl, add the flour, salt, and baking soda
Add the butter mixture to the bowl, with the egg and vanilla essence
Very lightly grease the bottom of a pan (~30cms in diameter) and apply the first layer of cookie dough
Chop up the bar of chocolate and add it on top
Cover with the second layer of dough
Cover the pan with a lid and leave it on the induction stove with a power of 350 (this one says 160°C)
Cook for 20-23 minutes then let rest for another 5-10 minutes. Cut up and serve
